micro.label: Microeconomics · Individual Choice and Markets
micro.subtitle: From supply-and-demand equilibrium and consumer and producer optimization to strategic interaction in market structures and information asymmetry, build the microeconomic foundations of economic analysis.

calculator.label: Pricing Fundamentals · Options and Implied Volatility
calculator.subtitle: From closed-form solutions and implied-volatility inversion to Monte Carlo simulation, understand the replication and risk-neutral logic behind pricing formulas.

implied-vol.label: Implied Volatility Solver
implied-vol.subtitle: Infer implied volatility from market prices using Newton-Raphson, and explore the volatility smile and term structure.

mc-pricer.label: Monte Carlo Option Pricing
mc-pricer.subtitle: Price European and path-dependent options with path simulation, compare results with closed-form solutions, and examine convergence and variance.

derivatives.label: Advanced Derivatives · Volatility Surfaces and Path Dependence
derivatives.subtitle: Bring market smiles, stochastic volatility, and American exercise into a unified experimental framework with SVI, Heston, SABR, Local Vol, and LSM.

bond.label: Fixed Income · Bonds and Cash Flows
bond.subtitle: From bond cash flows and yield to maturity to duration and convexity, understand how rate changes pass through to prices.

rate-model.label: Short-Rate Model Simulation
rate-model.subtitle: Simulate interest-rate paths and term structures using short-rate models such as Vasicek and CIR.

fixed-income-lab.label: Advanced Fixed Income · Credit/Short Rates/OAS/Curves
fixed-income-lab.subtitle: Merton and CDS-implied measures, Vasicek/CIR/HW term structures, OAS and PSA MBS, and TIPS butterflies.

frontier.label: Mean-Variance Efficient Frontier
frontier.subtitle: Build the efficient frontier, tangency portfolio, and capital market line to understand diversification and optimal allocation.

asset-pricing.label: Asset Pricing · CAPM and Multifactor Models
asset-pricing.subtitle: From the CAPM security market line to APT and Fama-French multifactor attribution, understand how systematic risk is priced.

econometrics.label: Econometrics · Estimation and State Space
econometrics.subtitle: Covers OLS, IV, GMM, GARCH, Kalman, and causal inference, with an emphasis on estimation assumptions, diagnostic tests, and robust inference.

risk.label: Risk Management · Credit, Dependence, and Stress Testing
risk.subtitle: From VaR/ES to Merton distance to default, Copula dependence, and scenario shocks, build an interpretable framework for tail-risk monitoring.

quant.label: Quant Strategies · Backtesting and Factor Attribution
quant.subtitle: Use auditable backtests, risk budgets, and multifactor attribution to break strategy ideas into signals, portfolio construction, and risk constraints.

macro.label: Macroeconomics · Growth and Dynamic Equilibrium
macro.subtitle: Use Solow, RBC/DSGE, and policy-shock simulations to examine long-run growth, technological progress, and the transmission mechanisms of dynamic equilibrium.

macro-lab.label: Advanced Macro Lab · Debt/FX/BGG/ZLB
macro-lab.subtitle: Blanchard r−g debt dynamics, Dornbusch exchange-rate overshooting, BOP three-gap model, BGG financial accelerator, ZLB, and the forward-guidance puzzle.

behavior-microstructure.label: Behavioral Finance & Market Microstructure Lab
behavior-microstructure.subtitle: Hyperbolic discounting / DSSW / disposition effect + Kyle / Glosten-Milgrom / Roll / Almgren-Chriss.

fred.label: FRED · Macroeconomic Time Series
fred.subtitle: Load and visualize real macroeconomic time series from the Federal Reserve's FRED database.

worldbank.label: World Bank · Development Indicators
worldbank.subtitle: Compare World Bank development indicators, including GDP growth and inflation, across countries.

ecb-bis.label: ECB / BIS · European Central Bank and Bank for International Settlements
ecb-bis.subtitle: Load official interest-rate, exchange-rate, and other data from the European Central Bank and Bank for International Settlements.

coingecko.label: CoinGecko · Crypto Assets
coingecko.subtitle: Load historical cryptocurrency prices, market capitalization, and volatility indicators.

alphavantage.label: Alpha Vantage · Equities and FX
alphavantage.subtitle: Load daily historical data for global equities and foreign exchange, and calculate annualized volatility and returns.

cboe-sentiment.label: CBOE Market Sentiment · VIX / SKEW / PCR
cboe-sentiment.subtitle: Use the VIX term structure, VVIX, SKEW, and equity put/call ratio to gauge fear and greed.

econ-calendar.label: Economic Calendar · CPI / NFP / FOMC
econ-calendar.subtitle: High-impact macro releases over the next two weeks, combining Trading Economics with a curated static calendar.

etf-lookup.label: ETF Lookup · Fees and AUM
etf-lookup.subtitle: Enter a ticker to instantly retrieve fees, AUM, category, and YTD performance from etfdb.com.

sector-heatmap.label: Sector Heatmap · 11 Sectors
sector-heatmap.subtitle: Visualize sector rotation using one-month returns for SPDR sector ETFs, with self-sourced data and a Finviz-style design.

market-cap.label: Global Market Cap Rankings · Top 50
market-cap.subtitle: Quarterly snapshots of the world's largest companies, with a clear comparison of industry and country distribution.

quiver-signals.label: Alternative Data Signals · Congressional Trading / WSB
quiver-signals.subtitle: Alternative data such as congressional trading and WSB retail investor activity (requires QUIVER_API_KEY).

external-workbench.label: External Research Workbench · Cross-Site Research in One Click
external-workbench.subtitle: Ticker-aware deep links to 10 research sites, including StockAnalysis, Finviz, Koyfin, and Seeking Alpha.

platform.label: Platform Enhancements · Notebooks, Real Data, and Cross-Tool Comparisons
platform.subtitle: Build platform capabilities around reproducibility, sharing, and comparison: real-data loading, model benchmarks, history, and public Notebooks.
